title: Risa's Cottage Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Risa's Cottage is a 1 BR / 1 BA / 4 Guest cottage in Seaside, FL. With the advantage of renting out a newly remodeled space, ‘Risa’s Cottage’ supplies a quaint vacation getaway for couples or small families on Seaside’s western side.
description_expanded: Description664 FOREST STREET1 QUEEN, 1 SLEEPER SOFACharming West Seaside Location on Forest StreetRisa’s Cottage offers a peaceful and intimate Seaside, Florida getaway, ideal for couples or small families seeking a relaxed coastal escape. Located on Forest Street on Seaside’s desirable west side—just nine cottages west of the iconic Seaside Chapel—this one-bedroom, one-bath guest cottage comfortably accommodates two adults and two small children. Guests enjoy designated parking for one vehicle directly in front of the home, along with easy access to all of Seaside’s renowned amenities.Private Guest Cottage with Courtyard SettingTucked behind the main residence, Life Is Good, Risa’s Cottage feels like a hidden retreat surrounded by mature trees and lush landscaping. Accessed via a quiet footpath and arbor gate, the cottage offers a sense of privacy while remaining close to the heart of town. A softly lit courtyard with perimeter lighting provides safe evening access, while a private outdoor patio and boardwalk offer inviting spaces to relax outdoors. Guests have exclusive use of an enclosed outdoor shower—perfect after beach days—as well as private laundry facilities conveniently located on-site.Outdoor Living Designed for RelaxationThe furnished front porch features elevated Adirondack seating for two and a garden stool, creating an ideal spot for morning coffee or sunset wine. The surrounding yard offers space for children to play while adults unwind nearby. A propane grill is available for casual outdoor meals, and bicycles can be securely stored within the enclosed courtyard, making it easy to explore Seaside on two wheels.Bright Living Area & Efficient KitchenInside, the cottage opens into a welcoming living and dining space filled with natural light. The living area includes a queen sleeper sofa, flat-screen Smart TV, and a custom built-in dining nook perfect for enjoying meals together. For added flexibility, the flip-up coffee tables can double as tray tables for casual dining while watching TV. The thoughtfully designed, economy-size kitchen is well-equipped for quick meals and beach-day breakfasts, featuring a small sink, induction cooktop, built-in microwave, and a Sub-Zero compartment refrigerator and freezer.Comfortable Bedroom with Private BathJust off the main living space, the serene bedroom offers a queen bed, dual nightstands, and ample natural light. The private ensuite bathroom includes a walk-in shower with a built-in bench, along with a spacious closet featuring built-in drawers and hanging space. Original artwork displayed throughout the cottage adds a thoughtful, local touch, enhancing the home’s warm and inviting atmosphere.Whether you’re planning a romantic Seaside retreat or a small family vacation, Risa’s Cottage delivers comfort, privacy, and a prime West Seaside location—all within walking distance of the beach, chapel, shops, and dining that make Seaside, Florida so special.* 3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURESOne-level cottagePrivate Seaside Beach access at the West Ruskin PavilionSeaside offers the largest private residential beach on 30A4-minute walk to the beach (approximately 352 yards)296 square feet of thoughtfully designed living spaceQueen sleeper sofa in the main living areaPeacock Alley linens, featuring fresh and luxurious towels and sheets throughout the cottageOutdoor propane grill available for guest useParking for one vehicle directly in front of the homePersonalized service throughout your stay, with starter amenities provided upon arrivalWelcome tote including two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary bikes available for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityAccess to Seaside amenities, including three swimming pools, five clay tennis courts, three pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerOne parking pass issued for this one-bedroom cottagePlease note: golf carts are considered vehicles. Golf carts for guests visiting Seaside are prohibited unless approved for special circumstances or medical needs with a permit.No pets allowedSTR23-002166
